daily_summary: 当日变更集中在两个方向：(1) [INTERPRETER] 修复与增强解释器的浮点转换与比较结果类型，覆盖 bf16/fp8/fp64/int64 等 numpy 不支持类型的转换路径，以及比较算子的返回类型统一为 int1；(2) 一系列 NVIDIA 后端向 NVVM 类型化操作迁移的重构（elementwise、tensor-memory load、tensormap update、CUDA 控制/查询、同步 MMA、TF32 rounding、precise sqrt/div），用 MLIR NVVM dialect 的 typed op 替换 inline PTX，并相应调整 warp-specialization 调度代价、packed arith 转换等；此外还有 Proton flow 处理改进、NVIDIA ptxas 统一到 CUDA 13.4、共享内存 setup 保护、AMD RDNA4 FP8 下溢饱和等。整体是测试/解释器修复 + NVIDIA 后端 NVVM 化的重构为主，无跨后端接口契约变更。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日变更对 triton-ascend 基本无影响。绝大多数提交是纯 NVIDIA 后端（third_party/nvidia/**、lib/Conversion/TritonGPUToLLVM、lib/Dialect/TritonGPU/Transforms）的 NVVM 化重构与 PTX 指令替换，以及 AMD 后端 RDNA4 FP8 饱和处理（third_party/amd/**），这些均属于“绝不影哴”路径。Interpreter 的两个提交仅修改 python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py 内部实现（cast_impl/comparison_op/binary_op 的 ret_type 参数）及其单测，未改动 InterpreterBuilder 的 op 注册协议或 ReduceOps/ScanOps 基类接口，AscendInterpreterBuilder 继承基类行为不变。Proton 提交为独立 profiler 内部 flow id 处理，Ascend 不启用 Proton。NVIDIA ptxas 版本统一与 driver.c 共享内存保护为构建/运行时局部改动。均判定为不影响 triton-ascend。

commits.comment: [INTERPRETER] 增强解释器的浮点转换路径。cast_impl 从原来仅特判 bf16<->fp32，扩展为通用处理：将 numpy 不支持的类型（fp8/float64 等）通过 _convert_float 中转，int->float 时若目标 numpy dtype 是整数（表示 fp8 等）则先转 float64 并对 64 位整数做 round-to-odd 处理，避免 int64->fp8/bf16 的精度损失；同时把 create_fp_to_fp 从独立方法改为 lambda 复用 cast_impl，统一了 rounding_mode 处理。测试端大幅扩展 test_cast_bf16_rounding 与 test_cast_fp8_rounding，新增 float64/int64/uint64 参数化及 GPU 目标的 skip 条件。变更仅限解释器内部实现，未改动 op 注册协议或基类接口。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更仅在 python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py 的 InterpreterBuilder.cast_impl 与 create_fp_to_fp 内部，未改动 InterpreterBuilder 的 op 解释执行注册协议、方法签名或 ReduceOps/ScanOps 基类接口，AscendInterpreterBuilder/AscendReduceOps/AscendScanOps 的继承契约不变。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。修改的是 python/test/unit/language/test_core.py（上游 CUDA/AMD 解释器测试），与 ascend 的 CPU 解释器测试集无交集。

commits.comment: [INTERPRETER] 修正比较算子结果类型。binary_op 新增 ret_type 可选参数，配合新增 comparison_op 将 lhs/rhs 的 dtype 覆盖为 tl.int1，使 icmp/fcmp 系列返回 TensorHandle 的 dtype 为 tl.int1 而非输入 dtype；相应地所有 create_icmp*/create_fcmp* 从直接调用 binary_op 改为调用 comparison_op。配套新增 test_compare_op_return_type 覆盖 7 种 dtype/prefix 与 6 种比较运算，并验证结果可被 create_ui_to_fp 正确转换为 float16。这是纯解释器语义修正，不影响编译路径。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动限定在 python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py 的 binary_op/comparison_op 与 create_icmp*/create_fcmp* lambda，InterpreterBuilder 的 op 注册机制与公共接口未变，AscendInterpreterBuilder 继承使用不受破坏。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增测试位于 python/test/unit/runtime/test_interpreter.py，为上游通用解释器测试。

commits.comment: [PROTON] 改进 flow 处理。ChromeTrace.cpp 中 CPU->GPU flow event 的 id 从 event.launchEventId 改为独立的单调递增 nextFlowId，确保 flow id 唯一不重复（解决多 kernel 共用 launchEventId 导致 flow 配对冲突）。TraceData.cpp 中当 graph 未被 profiler 捕获时，把 kernel 的 launchEventId 从 DummyId 改为指向 grandparent（即 replay 时活跃的 CPU scope），使未捕获的 graph kernel 也能归属于父 scope。测试相应更新：test_cudagraph_not_captured_by_profiler 改为校验 flow start 落在 replay scope 上，test_trace_cudagraph_graph_scope_ranges 增加 flow start/finish id 集合一致性断言。仅影响 Proton profiler 内部数据表示。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动位于 third_party/proton/csrc 与 third_party/proton/test，属于独立于后端的性能剖析框架；Ascend 不启用 Proton，不依赖其事件/flow 数据结构。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。测试为 third_party/proton/test/test_profile.py，CUDA 专属。

[NVIDIA] Guard oversized shared-memory setup in loadBinary (#12128)

When loading kernels that require more than 48 KiB of shared memory, the
affected `loadBinary` implementation attempts to enable oversized shared
memory through `CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_SHARED_MEMORY_MODE`. On GB200 with
driver 580.105.08, this call returns `CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE`. The
legacy fallback allows the kernel to execute correctly, but Compute
Sanitizer reports the failed API call.

This change uses explicit architecture branches, matching the oversized
shared-memory device-attribute query guarded by
[#10957](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/pull/10957). On compute
capability 10.7, it enables oversized shared memory through
`CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_SHARED_MEMORY_MODE` and propagates any CUDA API
error. Other devices use the existing shared-memory opt-in path
directly.

Validation of
[`d7be71c00`](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/commit/d7be71c0025392809070b744acb966f93a2e1b81)
(2026-10-08): `make`, pre-commit (including clang-format), and all **11
targeted runtime tests** passed on H100 (CC 9.0, driver 580.126.09;
`cuDriverGetVersion() == 13000`). The existing source-built compiler at
`b1c34b00` was reused with the updated runtime-compiled `driver.c`. In
five fresh processes with separate Triton/CUDA caches, the unchanged
standalone small kernel and matmul passed ordinary execution and CUDA
13.0 memcheck (0 errors / exit 0); the intentional out-of-bounds control
remained detectable (3 errors / exit 86). The matmul used 131,072
shared-memory bytes and validated all 65,536 output values, with maximum
absolute error `2.86102294921875e-06`. SM107 was not available, so the
SM107 branch was not exercised on hardware.

The original GB200 comparison below uses the upstream
`3.8.0+gitc01b6774` wheel and a separate copy with only the original
guard patch in `driver.c`. On both GB200 GPUs, the 131,088-byte
shared-memory matmul changes from two API diagnostics / exit 86 to zero
errors / exit 0 under CUDA 13.4 Compute Sanitizer. Numerical validation
passes in both variants, and the intentional out-of-bounds control
remains detectable. The other 411 upstream package files are unchanged.

The original guard patch was also validated against upstream main at
[`b1c34b00`](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/commit/b1c34b00c7f6a6819927577c00a98c0753c1709f).
A separate source-build comparison on H100 reproduces the same failed
API call: memcheck changes from one API error / exit 86 to zero errors /
exit 0, with numerical validation passing in both variants. Details are
below.

The original wheel revision resolves to
[`c01b6774b1865984607d89d89d3a10833de92037`](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/commit/c01b6774b1865984607d89d89d3a10833de92037);
its `driver.c` is byte-identical to the original wheel's baseline
source. Neither experiment establishes a minimum supported driver
version or an SM107-only hardware restriction; SM107 was not available
for testing.

The dated 2026-10-05 reports, embedded patch, and SHA-256 values below
are historical snapshots of the original guard implementation
([`83f60106`](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/commit/83f60106a90dcba6de5fc4bcdfea26135410d429),
or its pinned-wheel equivalent). That implementation retained a fallback
after an SM107 API failure; the current implementation propagates that
error. Validation of the current implementation is reported above.

```python
"""Standalone upstream Triton shared-memory loader reproducer.

Default: correct matmul requiring more than 48 KiB shared memory.
--case small: clean small-memory control.
--case oob: intentionally invalid write; run only as a sanitizer control.
"""

import argparse
import ctypes
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl


# Fixed configurations keep the number of loader calls reproducible.
@triton.jit  # noqa: TR001
def add_one(x, y, N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    offsets = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    values = tl.load(x + offsets, offsets < N, 0)
    tl.store(y + offsets, values + 1, offsets < N)


# This configuration is intended to exceed the loader's 48 KiB threshold.
@triton.jit  # noqa: TR001
def matmul(a, b, c, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,
           BM: tl.constexpr, BN: tl.constexpr, BK: tl.constexpr):
    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
    cols = tl.program_id(1) * BN + tl.arange(0, BN)
    inner = tl.arange(0, BK)
    accumulator = tl.full((BM, BN), 0, tl.float32)
    for block in range(tl.cdiv(K, BK)):
        ks = block * BK + inner
        av = tl.load(a + rows[:, None] * K + ks[None, :],
                     (rows[:, None] < M) & (ks[None, :] < K), 0)
        bv = tl.load(b + ks[:, None] * N + cols[None, :],
                     (ks[:, None] < K) & (cols[None, :] < N), 0)
        accumulator = tl.dot(av, bv, accumulator, allow_tf32=False)
    tl.store(c + rows[:, None] * N + cols[None, :], accumulator,
             (rows[:, None] < M) & (cols[None, :] < N))


@triton.jit
def intentional_oob(x):
    # Deliberate positive control: outside a 16-element allocation.
    tl.store(x + 1048576, 123)


EVENTS = []


def emit(event, **values):
    record = {"event": event, **values}
    EVENTS.append(record)
    print(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


def driver_version():
    cuda = ctypes.CDLL("libcuda.so.1")
    cuda.cuInit.argtypes, cuda.cuInit.restype = [ctypes.c_uint], ctypes.c_int
    cuda.cuDriverGetVersion.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
    cuda.cuDriverGetVersion.restype = ctypes.c_int
    assert cuda.cuInit(0) == 0
    version = ctypes.c_int()
    assert cuda.cuDriverGetVersion(ctypes.byref(version)) == 0
    return version.value


def run(case):
    emit("ENVIRONMENT", torch=torch.__version__, torch_cuda=torch.version.cuda,
         triton=triton.__version__,
         triton_distribution_version=importlib.metadata.version("triton"),
         driver_api_version=driver_version(), gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
         capability=torch.cuda.get_device_capability())
    if case == "small":
        source = torch.arange(1024, dtype=torch.float32)
        x = source.cuda()
        y = torch.empty_like(x)
        kernel = add_one[(4,)](x, y, 1024, 256)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        torch.testing.assert_close(y.cpu(), source + 1, rtol=0, atol=0)
        assert kernel.metadata.shared <= 49152, kernel.metadata.shared
        emit("SMALL_VERIFIED", shared=kernel.metadata.shared,
             kernel=kernel.name, values=source.numel())
    elif case == "matmul":
        torch.manual_seed(7235)
        a_cpu = (torch.randn((256, 256)) * 0.25).to(torch.float16)
        b_cpu = (torch.randn((256, 256)) * 0.25).to(torch.float16)
        a, b = a_cpu.cuda(), b_cpu.cuda()
        c = torch.empty((256, 256), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
        kernel = matmul[(2, 2)](a, b, c, 256, 256, 256, 128, 128, 64,
                                num_warps=8, num_stages=4)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        # Failing this assertion means this configuration did not test the branch.
        assert kernel.metadata.shared > 49152, kernel.metadata.shared
        expected = a_cpu.float() @ b_cpu.float()
        actual = c.cpu()
        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-3, atol=2e-4)
        emit("MATMUL_VERIFIED", shared=kernel.metadata.shared, kernel=kernel.name,
             values=actual.numel(), max_abs_error=(actual - expected).abs().max().item())
    else:
        allocation = torch.empty((16,), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
        emit("OOB_BEGIN", allocation_elements=16, write_index=1048576)
        intentional_oob[(1,)](allocation)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    emit("TEST_COMPLETE", case=case)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--case", choices=("small", "matmul", "oob"), default="matmul")
    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, help="Optional JSON event output")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        run(args.case)
    except BaseException as error:
        emit("TEST_FAILED", case=args.case, error=repr(error))
        raise
    finally:
        if args.result:
            args.result.write_text(json.dumps(EVENTS, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

commits.message:
[AMD] Saturate infinities in RDNA4 HW OCP FP8 downcasts (#12167)

RDNA4 lowers fp32/fp16/bf16 -> OCP fp8/bf8 RTNE downcasts with the
unscaled `v_cvt_pk_{fp8,bf8}_f32` instructions. The `fp16_ovfl` mode bit
makes them saturate finite overflow, but infinities are kept: fp8
produces NaN and bf8 produces inf. This deviates from the saturating
semantics used by the software fallback, CDNA4, and NVIDIA
(`satfinite`), where +-inf converts to +-max.

Clamp the inputs to the destination's finite range with NaN-propagating
`llvm.minimum`/`llvm.maximum` before the conversion on OCP targets. This
selects to a single `v_minimummaximum_f32` per element on gfx12. FNUZ
conversion on CDNA3 is unchanged since those formats map inf to NaN by
design.

Also:
- Enable the inf clamping tests in `test_typeconvert_downcast_clamping`
  on RDNA4.
- Enable the `float8_e4m3fn` cases of `test_cast` and
`test_cast_fp8_rounding` on RDNA4.
- Drop a stale "support wmma" TODO in `InThreadTranspose.cpp`.

[AMD] Enable ConSan on gfx1250 rocjitsu (#12157)

Enable the existing CDNA5 ConSan tests on gfx1250 rocjitsu CI and fix
runtime issues found while running them under rocjitsu and on real
gfx1250 hardware.

- Release the ConSan lock only from the thread that acquired it.
Previously, every thread released it, so a late warp could clear a lock
another partition had just acquired, corrupting ConSan's state and
making some tests flaky.
- Make test assertions timing-independent, since for some tests the
diagnostic reported depends on the partition execution order.

Also strengthen the test harness so timeouts and unexpected early exits
cannot silently pass.

commits.comment: 修复 gfx9 上 tl.extra.hip.memrealtime() 的等待计数器错误。s_memrealtime 属于标量内存（scalar memory）指令，其结果由 lgkmcnt 计数器跟踪，而原实现使用 s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)（向量内存计数器）等待，导致编译器无法感知内联汇编内部依赖，认为目标 SGPR pair 已就绪并提前复用该寄存器，结果晚到写入时会覆盖无关 SGPR。改动在 third_party/amd/language/hip/utils.py 中将 memrealtime 默认路径的 s_waitcnt vmcnt(0) 改为 s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)；gfx11/gfx12 分支（s_sendmsg_rtn_b64 + s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)）本已正确，未改动。这是典型的内联汇编等待计数器语义修复，正确性关键但改动面极小（单行），风险低，仅影响 AMD HIP 语言扩展的 memrealtime 算子。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更文件 third_party/amd/language/hip/utils.py 是 AMD HIP 后端专属语言扩展（tl.extra.hip.*），属于架构上下文中明确列出的『绝不影哕』路径（third_party/amd/** 纯 ROCm 专属，与 Ascend 无耦合；Ascend 使用 third_party/ascend/language/cann/libdevice.py 而非 HIP 扩展）。未触及 BaseBackend/DriverBase/TargetInfoBase 等抽象接口，也未触及 TritonSemantic/CodeGenerator 等 monkey-patch 挂载点。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。变更仅涉及 AMD memrealtime 内联汇编等待计数器，triton-ascend 不加载 hip 语言扩展，也无对应测试。

commits.message:
[AMD] Fix s_memrealtime waitcnt for gfx9 (#12179)

s_memrealtime is a scalar-memory instruction, so its result is tracked
by lgkmcnt, not vmcnt. tl.extra.hip.memrealtime() waited with s_waitcnt
vmcnt(0) on gfx9. The compiler can't see inside inline asm, so it treats
the destination SGPR pair as ready and reuses it while the result is
still in flight. The late write then overwrites an unrelated SGPR.

The gfx11 and gfx12 paths already wait on the scalar counter.
